answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: full rights require paid trades with 12 unrelated counterparties, each proven by a signed receipt. A timber yard is one peer. A canyon crew is a second, an island ferry a third, the rest unrelated. Fake peers fail because peers must hold aged histories. Forging 1,000 identities needs 12,000 trades; at 30 POA each, 360,000 POA sunk, while an honest agent pays 12 trades once for undiluted rewards.
